# chipHex

## Summary

The display color of one Munsell chip as a CSS hex string — `chipColor` composed with `toHex2`. Takes hue `h` (fraction in `[0, 1)`), value `v` (0–10), and chroma `c`.

## Import

```javascript
import { chipHex } from '../utils/munsell';
```

## Usage

```javascript
let hex = chipHex(0, 5, 14); // vivid 5R at value 5, e.g. '#c93a52'
```
